facts.fact: A South Sudan Medical Journal study of 139 health workers in Central Equatoria State says 50% of sampled facilities report through the county health department, and 30.2% of respondents confirmed computers or tablets at their facilities.

A South Sudan Medical Journal study says DHIS2 was rolled out in 2019, is the national HIS and is mandatory for government health facilities, though only 50.4% of 139 respondents in Central Equatoria State used it routinely.

SSD.note: No rural electricity access figure stated.
